step1.title: Continue with your email
step1.lead: No password: we send you a 6-digit code.

emailErrors.format: This email address is not valid (example: name@example.com).
emailErrors.tooLong: This email address is too long: 254 characters maximum.

errors.undeliverable: We cannot deliver email to this address. Check it, or use another address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes have been requested in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.serviceUnavailable: We cannot send your code right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

code.sent: If an account can be created or found with this address, a 6-digit code has just been sent. Please also check your spam folder.

errors.required: Enter the 6-digit code you received by email.
errors.invalid: This code is incorrect. You have {remaining, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
errors.expired: This code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts with this code. Request a new code.
errors.sessionLost: Your request has expired or was opened in another browser. Start again with your email address.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many sign-in attempts from this network. Please try again later, within an hour at most.
errors.verifyUnavailable: We cannot check your code right now. Please try again in a moment.

resend.countdown: You can request a new code in {seconds} seconds.
resend.limit: You have requested several codes. Use the last code you received: it is still valid.

step2.title: Enter the code

phrase.label: Your matching phrase
phrase.help: Check that it is identical in the email you received. If it is different, do not enter the code.

step2.stayInTab: Stay in this tab: the code only works here.

notReceived.label: I haven't received the code
notReceived.checklist: Check your spam folder and your “Promotions” or “Updates” tabs, then the spelling of your address.

roleMismatch.notice: This address is already linked to a {role, select, advertiser {brand} other {creator}} account. An INFLUX account holds a single role: use another address to create a second account.

internalAccount.title: Internal workspace
internalAccount.notice: This account is used from the INFLUX internal workspace.
internalAccount.help: No session has been opened here. Sign in from the internal workspace address you were given.

suspended.title: Account unavailable
suspended.notice: This account is not accessible. Please contact INFLUX.

signup.notYetAvailable: No account is linked to this address, and account creation is not open yet.

home.unavailable: Your space is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

advertiser.title: Brand space
advertiser.lead: Your space is being built: your campaigns and introductions will appear here.

creator.title: Creator space
creator.lead: Your space is being built: campaigns and your applications will appear here.
